Idents(all_merged_harmony_cluster_v2_PrepSCT_12sample_old_res0.5) <- " cluster_names"
Epi <- subset(CytoTRACE2_results, idents = c("Epithelial cells-1", "Epithelial cells-2", "Epithelial cells-3", 
                                                                                    "Epithelial cells-4", "Epithelial cells-5", "Epithelial cells-6", 
                                                                                    "Epithelial cells-7", "Epithelial cells-8", "Epithelial cells-9"))
Epi <- PrepSCTFindMarkers(Epi, assay = "SCT", verbose = TRUE)
Epi.markers <- FindAllMarkers(Epi, logfc.threshold = 1, min.pct = 0.05, verbose = TRUE, only.pos = TRUE)
Epi@active.ident <- factor(Epi@active.ident, 
                           levels = c("Epithelial cells-9", "Epithelial cells-8", "Epithelial cells-7", "Epithelial cells-6", 
                                      "Epithelial cells-5", "Epithelial cells-4", "Epithelial cells-3", "Epithelial cells-2", "Epithelial cells-1"))
FeaturePlot(Epi, features = "Cdh1", 
            cols = c("lightgrey", "#bb0c00"), raster = F, order = T)
